title: The lock and key model
caption: The substrate fits the active site because their shapes are complementary, forming an enzyme-substrate complex. After the reaction the products leave, and the enzyme is unchanged and can be used again.
alt: The lock and key model in three stages: an enzyme with an empty active site and a substrate of complementary shape; the substrate held in the active site; two products leaving an unchanged enzyme.
description: An enzyme with an active site, and a substrate whose shape fits it.
The substrate binds in the active site: an enzyme-substrate complex.
The reaction splits the substrate into two products, which leave.
The enzyme is the same shape as before.
